Hero License.name: Hero License
Hero License.description:
🪪 You are a licensed professional hero, certified by the Hero Public Safety Commission.

⚖️ You may use your Quirk in hero work, patrol, apprehend villains, and work for or found an agency.
⚠️ You report every incident and answer for any damage you cause. Misconduct can cost you the license.
🤝 You are a public figure: rankings, press, fans, sponsors and villains all watch you.
🔁 It replaces a Provisional Hero License if you hold one.

📈 Grants: Hero Law +5
🎒 Starts with: Hero license
Hero License.traitNarrativeEffects: Holds a full hero license from the Hero Public Safety Commission; it replaces a Provisional Hero License if held. Rights: Quirk use in public in the course of hero work; patrols; responding to crimes, accidents and disasters; apprehending villains and handing them to police; reasonable force; working as a sidekick, joining or founding an agency and hiring sidekicks; pay from agency contracts, government compensation and endorsements; a place on the Hero Billboard Chart JP, the official pro hero ranking. Duties: report every incident and Quirk use; respect police authority over investigations and crime scenes; use only the force needed; answer for injuries and property damage caused; answer Commission calls in a large crisis. Misconduct brings suspension or revocation and can bring criminal charges. A public figure: rankings, press, fans, sponsors and villains watch. A Quirkless holder works under the same rules with gear and training in place of a Quirk.
